author: product-requirements-expert
context: Fresh dispatch: staff cancel an upcoming visit from the owner detail page, and cancelling removes that visit from the pet's record. Scoping this into REQ-VIS-003 requires reopening NG-4 (deleting an owner, a pet, or a visit) or NG-5 (changing or cancelling a visit once booked). Both rows were confirmed deliberate on 2026-08-08 by adr/2026-08-08-non-goal-deletion-and-visit-amendment.md. That ADR states a future request touching either row proceeds only on an explicit owner decision recorded at intake. It further states the request itself never reopens the row. The dispatch names neither row and carries no owner decision. I therefore have no owner text to quote into scope_overrides, which Gate 1 requires for a Non-Goals change. I wrote nothing to docs/prd.md or docs/ubiquitous-language.md.
question: Which row do you narrow so cancelling a booked visit can be recorded as REQ-VIS-003? Option A: cancelling erases the visit. That narrows NG-4 for visits only and leaves NG-5 whole. Option B: cancelling marks the visit cancelled and hides it from the pet's record. That narrows NG-5 by adding visit lifecycle state and leaves NG-4 whole. Option C: neither row moves and the request is declined. I recommend Option A. The request says the visit is removed from the pet's record, which reads as erasure. Erasure adds no lifecycle state, and lifecycle state is the specific cost NG-5's rationale names. On Option A I record REQ-VIS-003 in the Visits section. I narrow NG-4 to owners and pets, write a non-goal ADR superseding the 2026-08-08 decision for that row, and add Cancel to the ubiquitous language. On Option B I do the same against NG-5 and add a Cancelled Visit term instead. On Option C I add an Open Questions entry and stop. Two resolutions I own and will apply under A or B unless you say otherwise. First, upcoming means dated later than today, matching the REQ-VIS-001 booking boundary. A visit dated today is therefore not cancellable; tell me if today should be included. Second, a cancelled visit leaves no trace visible to staff, since an audit trail is a separate capability nobody has asked for. Please state your decision in words I can quote verbatim into scope_overrides.
stop_state: No PRD or vocabulary edits made; REQ-VIS-003 minted and unrecorded. On an answer I draft the requirement, its Done when bullets and edge cases, the Non-Goals narrowing, the non-goal ADR, the vocabulary term, and the prd-entry.
